```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)

  # Remove trailing parenthetical information if present: TP20-M388(10) -> TP20-M388
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)$", "", x)

  # Common tumor/normal suffixes
  x <- gsub("(?i)_T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)_N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)-T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)-N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  # IMPACT-style suffixes:
  # TP03-117T  -> TP03-117
  # TP03-117NL -> TP03-117
  x <- gsub("(?i)NL$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  x
}

save_matrix <- function(mat, filename) {
  out_file <- file.path(RDS_DIR, filename)
  saveRDS(mat, out_file)
  message("[SAVED] ", out_file, " | dim = ", paste(dim(mat), collapse = " x "))
}

pick_col <- function(dt, candidates) {
  hits <- intersect(candidates, colnames(dt))
  if (length(hits) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hits[1]
}

collapse_duplicate_features <- function(mat) {
  mat <- as.data.frame(mat, check.names = FALSE)
  mat$Feature_ID <- rownames(mat)

  dt <- as.data.table(mat)
  value_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dt), "Feature_ID")

  dt[, (value_cols) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols = value_cols]

  dt2 <- dt[
    ,
    lapply(.SD, function(z) mean(z, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = Feature_ID,
    .SDcols = value_cols
  ]

  features <- dt2$Feature_ID
  dt2[, Feature_ID := NULL]

  out <- as.matrix(dt2)
  rownames(out) <- features
  storage.mode(out) <- "numeric"
  out
}

encode_cnv <- function(x) {
  y <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))

  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(y))

  out[y %in% c("HOMDEL", "HOMD", "HOM_DEL", "HOMOZYGOUSDELETION",
               "HOMOZYGOUS_DELETION", "DEEPDELETION", "DEEP_DELETION", "-2")] <- -2

  out[y %in% c("HETDEL", "HETD", "HET_DEL", "HETEROZYGOUSDELETION",
               "HETEROZYGOUS_DELETION", "LOSS", "DEL", "DELETION", "-1")] <- -1

  out[y %in% c("NEUTRAL", "DIPLOID", "NORMAL", "0", "NONE", "NA", "")] <- 0

  out[y %in% c("GAIN", "LOWGAIN", "LOW_GAIN", "LOW-LEVEL_GAIN", "1")] <- 1

  out[y %in% c("AMP", "AMPLIFICATION", "HLAMP", "HIGHLEVELAMPLIFICATION",
               "HIGH_LEVEL_AMPLIFICATION", "HIGH-LEVEL_AMPLIFICATION", "2")] <- 2

  suppressWarnings({
    numeric_y <- as.numeric(y)
    idx <- is.na(out) & !is.na(numeric_y)
    out[idx] <- numeric_y[idx]
  })

  out
}

collapse_extreme_cnv <- function(z) {
  z <- z[!is.na(z)]
  if (length(z) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  z[which.max(abs(z))]
}

nonsilent_filter <- function(dt, class_col) {
  if (is.na(class_col)) return(dt)

  silent_classes <- c(
    "Silent",
    "Intron",
    "IGR",
    "RNA",
    "lincRNA",
    "3'UTR",
    "5'UTR",
    "3'Flank",
    "5'Flank",
    "Splice_Region"
  )

  dt[!dt[[class_col]] %in% silent_classes, , drop = FALSE]
}

make_presence_matrix <- function(sample_sets) {
  all_samples <- sort(unique(unlist(sample_sets)))

  presence <- data.table(Sample = all_samples)

  for (nm in names(sample_sets)) {
    presence[, (nm) := Sample %in% sample_sets[[nm]]]
  }

  presence
}

make_pairwise_overlap <- function(sample_sets) {
  mods <- names(sample_sets)
  res <- list()

  k <- 1
  for (i in seq_along(mods)) {
    for (j in seq_along(mods)) {
      a <- mods[i]
      b <- mods[j]

      res[[k]] <- data.table(
        Modality_1 = a,
        Modality_2 = b,
        N_modality_1 = length(sample_sets[[a]]),
        N_modality_2 = length(sample_sets[[b]]),
        N_overlap = length(intersect(sample_sets[[a]], sample_sets[[b]]))
      )
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }

  rbindlist(res)
}

add_missing_sample_columns <- function(mat, all_samples) {
  missing_samples <- setdiff(all_samples, colnames(mat))

  if (length(missing_samples) > 0) {
    na_mat <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = nrow(mat),
      ncol = length(missing_samples),
      dimnames = list(rownames(mat), missing_samples)
    )

    mat <- cbind(mat, na_mat)
  }

  mat[, all_samples, drop = FALSE]
}
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. RNA-seq log2TPM matrix
# ============================================================

message("\n==============================")
message("1. Processing RNA-seq")
message("==============================")

rna_dt <- fread(RNAseq, data.table = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

gene_col <- colnames(rna_dt)[1]
rna_genes <- rna_dt[[gene_col]]
rna_dt[[gene_col]] <- NULL

rna_mat <- as.matrix(rna_dt)
rownames(rna_mat) <- rna_genes
colnames(rna_mat) <- clean_sample(colnames(rna_mat))
storage.mode(rna_mat) <- "numeric"

rna_mat <- collapse_duplicate_features(rna_mat)

rna_var <- apply(rna_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
keep <- is.finite(rna_var) & rna_var > 0

rna_mat <- rna_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
rna_var <- rna_var[keep]

top_n <- min(TOP_N_RNA_GENES, nrow(rna_mat))
top_genes <- names(sort(rna_var, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(top_n)]
rna_top <- rna_mat[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

save_matrix(rna_mat, "RNA_log2TPM_allgenes.rds")
save_matrix(rna_top, paste0("RNA_log2TPM_top", TOP_N_RNA_GENES, "var.rds"))

fwrite(
  data.table(
    Raw_sample = colnames(rna_dt),
    Clean_sample = clean_sample(colnames(rna_dt))
  ),
  file.path(QC_DIR, "RNA_sample_name_map.csv")
)

fwrite(
  data.table(Gene = names(rna_var), Variance = rna_var)[order(-Variance)],
  file.path(QC_DIR, "RNA_gene_variance_ranked.csv")
)

rna_samples <- sort(unique(colnames(rna_mat)))
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. WES mutation matrix from MAF
# ============================================================

message("\n==============================")
message("2. Processing WES MAF")
message("==============================")

maf <- fread(WES_MAF_FILE, data.table = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

wes_gene_col <- pick_col(maf, c("Hugo_Symbol", "SYMBOL", "Gene", "gene"))
wes_sample_col <- pick_col(maf, c("Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Sample", "sample", "Sample_ID", "TUMOR_SAMPLE"))
wes_class_col <- pick_col(maf, c("Variant_Classification", "Consequence", "Effect"))

if (is.na(wes_gene_col) || is.na(wes_sample_col)) {
  stop("Could not detect gene/sample columns in WES MAF.")
}

wes_sample_map <- data.table(
  Raw_sample = unique(maf[[wes_sample_col]]),
  Clean_sample = clean_sample(unique(maf[[wes_sample_col]]))
)

fwrite(wes_sample_map, file.path(QC_DIR, "WES_MAF_sample_name_map.csv"))

maf <- nonsilent_filter(maf, wes_class_col)

mut_dt <- data.table(
  Gene = maf[[wes_gene_col]],
  Sample = clean_sample(maf[[wes_sample_col]]),
  Mutated = 1L
)

mut_dt <- mut_dt[!is.na(Gene) & Gene != "" & !is.na(Sample) & Sample != ""]

mut_wide <- dcast(
  unique(mut_dt),
  Gene ~ Sample,
  value.var = "Mutated",
  fill = 0,
  fun.aggregate = max
)

mut_genes <- mut_wide$Gene
mut_wide[, Gene := NULL]

wes_mut_mat <- as.matrix(mut_wide)
rownames(wes_mut_mat) <- mut_genes
storage.mode(wes_mut_mat) <- "numeric"

wes_mut_count <- rowSums(wes_mut_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
wes_mut_recurrent <- wes_mut_mat[wes_mut_count >= MIN_MUTATED_SAMPLES, , drop = FALSE]

save_matrix(wes_mut_mat, "WES_mutation_binary_allgenes.rds")
save_matrix(wes_mut_recurrent, paste0("WES_mutation_binary_recurrent_min", MIN_MUTATED_SAMPLES, ".rds"))

fwrite(
  data.table(Gene = names(wes_mut_count), Mutated_samples = wes_mut_count)[order(-Mutated_samples)],
  file.path(QC_DIR, "WES_mutation_gene_frequency.csv")
)

wes_mut_samples <- sort(unique(colnames(wes_mut_mat)))
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 3. WES CNV matrix
# ============================================================

message("\n==============================")
message("3. Processing WES CNV")
message("==============================")

cnv <- fread(WES_CNV_FILE, data.table = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

cnv_sample_col <- pick_col(cnv, c("Sample", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Sample_ID", "TUMOR_SAMPLE"))
cnv_gene_col <- pick_col(cnv, c("SYMBOL", "Hugo_Symbol", "Gene", "gene"))
cnv_class_col <- pick_col(cnv, c("VARIANT_CLASS", "Variant_Class", "CNV", "CNV_Call", "Alteration", "Call"))

if (is.na(cnv_sample_col) || is.na(cnv_gene_col) || is.na(cnv_class_col)) {
  stop("Could not detect Sample/SYMBOL/VARIANT_CLASS columns in WES CNV file.")
}

fwrite(
  data.table(
    Raw_sample = unique(cnv[[cnv_sample_col]]),
    Clean_sample = clean_sample(unique(cnv[[cnv_sample_col]]))
  ),
  file.path(QC_DIR, "WES_CNV_sample_name_map.csv")
)

cnv_dt <- data.table(
  Gene = cnv[[cnv_gene_col]],
  Sample = clean_sample(cnv[[cnv_sample_col]]),
  CNV_call = cnv[[cnv_class_col]]
)

cnv_dt <- cnv_dt[!is.na(Gene) & Gene != "" & !is.na(Sample) & Sample != ""]
cnv_dt[, CNV_numeric := encode_cnv(CNV_call)]

fwrite(
  unique(cnv_dt[, .(Original_CNV_call = CNV_call, Encoded_CNV_numeric = CNV_numeric)]),
  file.path(QC_DIR, "WES_CNV_encoding_check.csv")
)

cnv_wide <- dcast(
  cnv_dt,
  Gene ~ Sample,
  value.var = "CNV_numeric",
  fun.aggregate = collapse_extreme_cnv,
  fill = 0
)

cnv_genes <- cnv_wide$Gene
cnv_wide[, Gene := NULL]

wes_cnv_mat <- as.matrix(cnv_wide)
rownames(wes_cnv_mat) <- cnv_genes
storage.mode(wes_cnv_mat) <- "numeric"

wes_cnv_binary <- wes_cnv_mat
wes_cnv_binary[!is.na(wes_cnv_binary) & wes_cnv_binary != 0] <- 1
wes_cnv_binary[!is.na(wes_cnv_binary) & wes_cnv_binary == 0] <- 0

save_matrix(wes_cnv_mat, "WES_CNV_numeric.rds")
save_matrix(wes_cnv_binary, "WES_CNV_binary.rds")

wes_cnv_freq <- rowSums(wes_cnv_binary == 1, na.rm = TRUE)

fwrite(
  data.table(Gene = names(wes_cnv_freq), CNV_altered_samples = wes_cnv_freq)[order(-CNV_altered_samples)],
  file.path(QC_DIR, "WES_CNV_gene_frequency.csv")
)

wes_cnv_samples <- sort(unique(colnames(wes_cnv_mat)))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 5. Sample sanity checks
# ============================================================

message("\n==============================")
message("5. Sample-level sanity checks")
message("==============================")

sample_sets <- list(
  RNAseq = rna_samples,
  WES_MAF = wes_mut_samples,
  WES_CNV = wes_cnv_samples,
  IMPACT = impact_samples
)

sample_count_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(sample_sets), function(nm) {
  data.table(
    Modality = nm,
    N_samples = length(sample_sets[[nm]])
  )
}))

fwrite(sample_count_summary, file.path(QC_DIR, "MOFA2_modality_sample_counts.csv"))

presence <- make_presence_matrix(sample_sets)
fwrite(presence, file.path(QC_DIR, "MOFA2_sample_presence_matrix.csv"))

pairwise <- make_pairwise_overlap(sample_sets)
fwrite(pairwise, file.path(QC_DIR, "MOFA2_pairwise_sample_overlap.csv"))

common_all <- Reduce(intersect, sample_sets)

fwrite(
  data.table(Sample = sort(common_all)),
  file.path(QC_DIR, "MOFA2_common_samples_all_modalities.csv")
)

for (nm in names(sample_sets)) {
  fwrite(
    data.table(Sample = sort(sample_sets[[nm]])),
    file.path(QC_DIR, paste0("Samples_", nm, ".csv"))
  )
}

message("\nSample count by modality:")
print(sample_count_summary)

message("\nPairwise overlap:")
print(pairwise)

message("\nSamples common to all modalities: ", length(common_all))
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 6. Create MOFA2 data lists
# ============================================================

message("\n==============================")
message("6. Creating MOFA2 data lists")
message("==============================")

data_list_core <- list(
  RNA_log2TPM_top5000var = rna_top,
  WES_mutation_recurrent = wes_mut_recurrent,
  WES_CNV_numeric = wes_cnv_mat,
  IMPACT_mutation_recurrent = impact_mut_recurrent
)

# Remove empty views, if any
data_list_core <- data_list_core[sapply(data_list_core, function(x) nrow(x) > 0 & ncol(x) > 0)]

# A. Common sample list: strict complete-case MOFA input
if (length(common_all) > 0) {
  data_list_common <- lapply(data_list_core, function(mat) {
    mat[, sort(common_all), drop = FALSE]
  })

  saveRDS(
    data_list_common,
    file.path(RDS_DIR, "MOFA2_data_list_common_all_modalities.rds")
  )

  message("[SAVED] ", file.path(RDS_DIR, "MOFA2_data_list_common_all_modalities.rds"))
} else {
  message("[WARNING] No sample is common to all modalities. Common-only MOFA list not generated.")
}

# B. Union sample list with NA for missing modality measurements
# This is useful because not all samples are available in all modalities.
all_samples_union <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(data_list_core, colnames))))

data_list_union <- lapply(data_list_core, function(mat) {
  add_missing_sample_columns(mat, all_samples_union)
})

saveRDS(
  data_list_union,
  file.path(RDS_DIR, "MOFA2_data_list_union_samples_NA.rds")
)

message("[SAVED] ", file.path(RDS_DIR, "MOFA2_data_list_union_samples_NA.rds"))

view_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(names(data_list_union), function(v) {
  mat <- data_list_union[[v]]

  data.table(
    View = v,
    Features = nrow(mat),
    Samples = ncol(mat),
    Missing_values = sum(is.na(mat)),
    Percent_missing = round(100 * mean(is.na(mat)), 2)
  )
}))

fwrite(view_summary, file.path(QC_DIR, "MOFA2_view_summary_union_samples.csv"))

message("\nMOFA2 view summary:")
print(view_summary)

message("\nDONE.")
message("Check outputs in:")
message("  RDS: ", RDS_DIR)
message("  QC : ", QC_DIR)

```
